sn21.1:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Savatthi in Jeta’s Grove, Anathapiṇḍika’s Park.
sn21.1:1.3: There the Venerable Mahamoggallana addressed the bhikkhus thus:
sn21.1:2.2: “Here, friends, while I was alone in seclusion, a reflection arose in my mind thus:
sn21.1:2.6: ‘Here, with the subsiding of thought and examination, a bhikkhu enters and dwells in the second jhana, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, is without thought and examination, and has rapture and happiness born of concentration.
sn21.1:2.8: “Then, friends, with the subsiding of thought and examination, I entered and dwelt in the second jhana, which … has rapture and happiness born of concentration.
sn21.1:2.9: While I dwelt therein, perception and attention accompanied by thought assailed me.
sn21.1:3.1: “Then, friends, the Blessed One came to me by means of spiritual power and said this:
sn21.1:3.2: ‘Moggallana, Moggallana, do not be negligent regarding noble silence, brahmin. Steady your mind in noble silence, unify your mind in noble silence, concentrate your mind on noble silence.’
sn21.1:3.3: Then, friends, on a later occasion, with the subsiding of thought and examination, I entered and dwelt in the second jhana, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, is without thought and examination, and has rapture and happiness born of concentration.
sn21.1:3.4: “If, friends, one speaking rightly could say of anyone:
sn21.1:3.5: ‘He is a disciple who attained to greatness of direct knowledge with the assistance of the Teacher,’ it is of me that one could rightly say this.”
